sections.content: If statements let code make decisions. When a condition is true, the block inside runs; otherwise it is skipped.
Most languages also offer else (run when false) and elif/else-if (try another condition). Conditions must evaluate to true or false.
Key points: indentation or braces define the block, conditions use comparison operators, and you can chain else-if for multiple cases.
